verdict_msg: HARD_FAIL: DERIVED signal is IN-BAND and non-injected (auc_unrel=0.7476, auc_pooled=0.8759) but does NOT translate into a usable gate: mean_delta_hard_unrel=0.0000 mean_delta_mult_unrel=-0.0600 both <= 0.02 (ties/loses ungated baseline). shuffled-control deltas hard=[-0.06000000000000005] mult=[-0.20000000000000007]. Per pre-registered mechanism hypothesis: with R_UNRELIABLE=0.25 and n_obs in [4,6], most unreliable items carry 0-1 true observations; a singleton true draw has no reinforcing partner and is statistically indistinguishable from a corrupt draw under this cross-consistency score, so gating on it is a wash-to-negative even though the AGGREGATE auc_unrel looks decent (driven by the minority of items with >=2 true draws, which the ungated baseline already handles well). Genuine negative: derived cross-observation consistency does not close the reliability-estimation gap here.
